# The artwork is generated by init_app.sh and is not committed, so glob it at
# configure time. It is embedded as big resources: 1025 files that never change
# would otherwise be recompiled on every build.
file(GLOB_RECURSE POKEMON_IMAGES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} images/*.webp)
if (NOT POKEMON_IMAGES)
	message(WARNING "no images found in src/images - run ./init_app.sh to generate them")
endif()

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Qml Quick Sql)

add_library(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} main.cpp)

# Install as /usr/lib/poke-dex.so (no "lib" prefix) so that the booster derives
# the app name "poke-dex" and finds poke-dex.desktop for the window title.
set_target_properties(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES PREFIX "")

# QML files live at qrc:/Pokedex/*, and the C++ types are registered by the
# module's generated code (NO_PLUGIN), so no manual qmlRegisterType call is
# needed.
qt_add_qml_module(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
	URI Pokedex
	VERSION 1.0
	RESOURCE_PREFIX "/"
	NO_PLUGIN
	QML_FILES
		main.qml
		GenerationListPage.qml
		PokemonPage.qml
		PokemonItem.qml
		TypeChip.qml
		StatBar.qml
	SOURCES
		pokemonrepository.cpp
		pokemonrepository.h
		pokemonlistmodel.cpp
		pokemonlistmodel.h
)

if (POKEMON_IMAGES)
	qt_add_resources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} pokemon_images
		PREFIX "/"
		BASE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
		BIG_RESOURCES
		FILES ${POKEMON_IMAGES})
endif()

target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC
	Asteroid::AsteroidApp6)

target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE Qt6::Sql)
install(TARGETS ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
	DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})


install(FILES db/pokemon.db DESTINATION /usr/share/pokemon/)
